source.primary_witnesses: Aramaic DSS fragments (4Q201-4Q207; late 3rd c. BCE through 1st c. BCE) where preserved; Greek Akhmim Panopolitanus (6th c. CE) where Aramaic absent; Ge'ez (medieval; the only complete witness) as fallback
source.transliteration_convention: Scholarly conventions: Aramaic Imperial-Aramaic transliteration per Milik 1976 (ḥ ṣ ʿ ḫ); Greek SBL convention (η→ē, ω→ō, θ→th, etc., matching Matthew precedent); Ge'ez SBL Ge'ez convention (ḫ ḫ̣ ʾ ʿ ä for ä-vowel)
source.verificationStatus: best-effort reconstruction; verification pending against Milik 1976 DJD apparatus + Nickelsburg 2001 Hermeneia + original codicology
source.fetchedFrom: Milik 1976 The Books of Enoch + Black 1985 Greek text + Charles 1912 Ge'ez PD + Knibb 1978 Ge'ez critical edition + Nickelsburg 2001 Hermeneia commentary
source.citation: Milik 1976 The Books of Enoch (Oxford); Black 1985 The Book of Enoch or 1 Enoch (SVTP 7, Leiden); Nickelsburg 2001 1 Enoch 1 Hermeneia; Charles 1912 The Book of Enoch (Oxford, PD); Knibb 1978 The Ethiopic Book of Enoch (Oxford); Tigchelaar-García Martínez 2000 DJD XXXVI; VanderKam 1984 Enoch and the Growth of an Apocalyptic Tradition.
source.paleography_note: CHAPTER 28 — EASTERN AROMATIC WILDERNESS — Aramaic 4Q206 1 xx partial; Greek Akhmim 28:1-3 complete; Ge'ez full. Beginning of the third cosmic tour (the eastern paradise).

verses.text_greek: Καὶ ἐκεῖθεν ἀπῆλθον εἰς τὸ μέσον τοῦ Μανδοβάρα, καὶ εἶδον ἔρημον καὶ μόνον· ἦν δὲ μεστὸς δένδρων καὶ ἐκ τῶν σπερμάτων.
verses.translit: Kai ekeithen apēlthon eis to meson tou Mandobara, kai eidon erēmon kai monon; ēn de mestos dendrōn kai ek tōn spermatōn.
verses.text_geez: ወእምህየ፡ ሖርኩ፡ ውስተ፡ ማእከለ፡ መንዶባራ፡ ወርእኩ፡ ገዳመ፡ በሕቱ፡ ዘባሕቱ፡ ሀሎ፡ ብዙኀ፡ ዕፀወ፡ ወእምነ፡ ዘርእ፡
verses.notes: **Mandobara** — a transliteration of Semitic 'wilderness' (מדבר, midbar) into Greek as a quasi-proper-noun. Likely the Judean wilderness in the Akhmim's interpretation, but the cosmic-geographical sense is the eastern wilderness preceding paradise.
Waters running over them — life-giving stream in the wilderness.

verses.text_greek: Καὶ ἐφαίνετο πεπληρωμένον ὕδατος, καὶ ὡς ὑδραγωγὸς ἐπερρύη τόπος αὐτῷ ἀπὸ τοῦ βορρᾶ, καὶ ὕδωρ καὶ δρόσος ἔφερεν.
verses.translit: Kai ephaineto peplērōmenon hydatos, kai hōs hydragōgos eperryē topos autō apo tou borra, kai hydōr kai drosos epheren.
verses.text_geez: ወአስተርእየ፡ ምሉእ፡ ማይ፡ ወከመ፡ ሞጻጻ፡ ይውኅዝ፡ መካን፡ እምሰሜን፡ ወማይ፡ ወጠል፡ ይውኅዝ፡
verses.notes: Aqueduct-like flow of water and dew from the north. The fertile-wilderness motif. Cross-corpus: Isa 35:6-7 ('waters shall break forth in the wilderness'); Isa 41:18; Isa 51:3.
